fact: A tender listing records that UNDP in South Sudan issued notice UNDP-SSD-00648 on 12 March 2026, closing 31 March 2026, for the pilot implementation of OpenMRS at Al Sabah Children's Hospital and Munuki PHCC; the listing does not say whether a contract was awarded or whether the pilot covers general care.
title: Pilot Implementation of OpenMRS at Al Sabah Children's Hospital and Munuki PHCC
